entities.name: DNA methylation of pain-related genes in placenta

relationships.subject: prenatal opioid exposure
relationships.object: DNA methylation of pain-related genes in placenta
relationships.evidence_quote: The study identified significant methylation changes at 111 CpG sites in pain-related genes among opioid-exposed infants, with 54 CpGs hypomethylated and 57 hypermethylated.

key_findings: Placental DNA methylation of 111 CpG sites in pain-related genes differs in opioid-exposed infants with or without NOWS.
Differentially methylated genes include BDNF, SLC12A5 (KCC2), TNF, IL1B and OPRM1, enriched in cAMP and MAPK signaling pathways.
